data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to display PDF files on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Shows PDF documents using native views on mobile platforms. Includes iOS WKWebView support and zoom functionality. Works on physical devices after proper Android release configuration.
use_when: You need a quick way to embed PDF viewing in a Flutter app without heavy dependencies.
You target Android and iOS and only require basic viewing capabilities.
avoid_when: You require advanced PDF features like annotation, editing, or form filling.
You need Web, desktop, or Linux support despite the platform list.
strengths: Simple API and easy to add as a dependency
Supports both Android and iOS out of the box
Handles iOS deprecation by using WKWebView
Works on physical devices after Android release tweaks
weaknesses: Limited to basic viewing; no advanced PDF manipulation
No explicit support for web/desktop despite platform declaration
Requires manual Android NDK filter configuration for release builds
data.setup_notes: Add NDK abiFilters (e.g., 'armeabi-v7a') and ProGuard settings in Android build.gradle as shown in the README. No extra permissions required beyond standard internet access.
